SPCX.headline: Why SpaceX’s Multi-Billion Dollar Debt Sale Is Already Losing Money for Investors
SPCX.summary: SpaceX’s  $25 billion bond deal in late June has proven to be a dud amid apparent investor concern that the company will rely on the debt markets for its massive projected capital spending over the coming years.
